caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object composed of several joined cylindrical and circular sections. At the base, there is a wide, shallow circular tray with a slightly raised rim, rendered in shades of gray. Rising from the center of this base is a vertical, cylindrical column that widens at the bottom. At the top of this column another shallow circular pan is attached horizontally. Protruding from the middle section of this column, just below the upper pan, is a curved handle, also shaded gray. In the upper section, inside the circular pan, there is a vertically oriented, irregularly shaped metallic component with a pointed tip and an oval cut-out near its top. Beside it rests a coiled or knotted string or piece of fabric. The entire drawing is executed in grayscale tones with detailed shading, and it is set against a tan background. The name “CLAUDE H. MARSHALL” is printed in small capital letters in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Betty Lamp and Stand
